scope: Five fixed local original PDFs; result tables and current project notes re-read. Historical paper metrics, not reproduced model performance. Dynamic official web documentation not re-fetched in this review.
content_review: Wide & Deep acquisition-rate baseline and relative gain preserved.
DeepFM Criteo columns and absolute AUC differences correct.
DIN Amazon columns distinguished from MovieLens; its weighted metric scope retained.
DIEN public benchmark distinguished from DIN paper benchmark.
BST WDL baseline and response-time columns correctly identified.
Feature plan keeps hour-level tie limitations, missing exposure/money limits and prediction cutoffs.
Experiment plan includes grouped stratified contrast and time-purged evaluation; proposed experiments remain planned.
